run_deduplicate_lines: run the script to remove duplicate lines from one or more input text files
run_deduplicate_lines_with_workers: run the deduplication script with a custom number of multiprocessing workers
run_deduplicate_lines_stdin: run the deduplication script reading from stdin when no input files are provided
review_get_hashes_and_lines: review the get_hashes_and_lines function that computes an MD5 hash for a raw line
refactor_main_deduplication: refactor the main deduplication logic to use a different hashing algorithm instead of MD5
